armingRules: After a confirmed Robinhood buy fill, add one ACTIVE record with ticker, assetClass, saved stop, target1, target2, exit policy, runner allowance, armedAt, and dayTradeSeedLane=true only for a same-day seed fill.

entry is required for every ACTIVE position (stock and crypto): the live Robinhood average cost basis at fill time (or the current blended average after a later fill on the same ticker). Used by the 5% early-profit-trim trigger, in addition to crypto's existing post-Target-1 stop management use.

Crypto ticker must be Alpaca's slash format (e.g. PEPE/USD), not Robinhood's hyphen/no-separator form -- the trigger monitor's price lookup consumes this field verbatim against Alpaca, and a mismatched symbol degrades the entire board's monitorHealth, not just this position.
For a fractional position, the trigger monitor is not considered armed until the ACTIVE record is successfully written and the 5-minute trigger workflow is healthy.
After a confirmed Target 1 sell, set target1Completed=true. After Target 2 completion or a full exit, set target2Completed=true or status=CLOSED.

TRIGGER_EARLY_PROFIT_TRIM fires once a position is at least 5% above its recorded entry and earlyTrimCompleted is not already true (user-authorized 2026-09-21, to keep capital cycling rather than waiting only for the full target). After executing it, sell roughly half the live position and set earlyTrimCompleted=true so it does not re-fire on the same cost basis; a later fill that changes entry should reset earlyTrimCompleted=false.
Never infer a fill or close from market price alone. Robinhood confirmation remains authoritative.

A position with dayTradeLaneMergeAuthorized:true may accept a fresh day-trade-lane fill on top of an existing swing lot: fill it, keep dayTradeSeedLane=false (no forced same-day flatten) for the combined position, and refresh stop/target1/target2 to the triggering cycle's published levels.
